cycle.claim_boundary: This finite audit covers the sealed 17x17 zero-mean-forced fixed-leaf quadratic W2/R2 coefficients, six uncapped TT-SVD tensorizations and the recorded CPU/NumPy/BLAS environment. It does not establish a result for TT generally, TT-cross, rank-capped rounding, GPU or parallel cost, full 64-step TT rollout, higher coefficients, other grids, forces or walls, D3Q27, SSM existence or uniqueness, normal attraction or a basin.
